Name: Ilucie's Krobi
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
Well, I was bored again (who would have thought...), and this time, the project born of my boredom is Krobi!

Krobi is a mini-Krobus that you can adopt from Marnie. It lives in peaceful coexistence with your other animals and, if treated well, brings you Void Essences from its nightly adventures.

But beware: Krobi is a natural resident of the Shadow Realm, and sometimes it might bring you Tiny Black Holes instead. Due to their size, these are completely harmless to you. You can place them in a Void Reactor to convert them into Battery Packs. The recipe for the Void Reactor is available from the start.

Have fun with Krobi, and treat it well!



The mod has i18n support, with English as the default language.
German is also available.
